summary: The Hadoop Ecosystem Engineer specializes in integrating and managing multiple Hadoop ecosystem components to deliver end-to-end big data solutions.
responsibilities: Design solutions using Hive, HBase, Sqoop, Flume, Kafka, and Spark
Integrate Hadoop with relational and NoSQL databases
Develop data ingestion and transformation pipelines
Support analytics and reporting use cases

education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant field

skills_required.name: Strong experience across the Hadoop ecosystem
Programming in Java, Python, or Scala
Knowledge of batch and streaming data processing
